senses.gloss:
गौतमः N. of(1) the sage
Bhāradvāja; (2) of Śatānanda, Gotama's
son; (3) N. of Kṛpa, Droṇa's
brother-in-law; (4) of Buddha; (5)
of the propounder of the Nyāya
system of philosophy.
--Comp.
--संभवा the river Godāvarī.

1 N. of Kṛpī, wife of
Droṇa.
--2 An epithet of the
Godāvarī.
--3 The teaching of
Buddha.
--4 The Nyāya system
of philosophy propounded by
Gautama.
--5 Turmeric.
--6 A kind
of yellow pigment.
--7 An epithet
of Durgā.
--8 N. of the river
Gomatī.
